name: Agent Inventory & Registry
description: Maintains a comprehensive inventory of all deployed AI agents, their capabilities, data access permissions, and operational status. Every agent must be registered before it can operate, ensuring complete organizational visibility into the agent fleet.
threat_addressed: Unregistered agents operate outside organizational visibility. Shadow agent deployments create unmonitored attack surfaces and ungoverned data access points that compliance programs cannot cover.
enforcement_mechanism: Complete, current registry of all deployed AI agents with required fields: unique ID, name, owner, purpose, creation date, last-activity, authorized tools, data classification tags, and deployment environment. Discovery scans detect unregistered agents.

security_outcome.pass: Registry is complete (no unregistered agents in production). All required fields populated. Updated within defined cycle.
security_outcome.fail: Agent not registered or inventory record incomplete.

display_detail: Validates that the agent is registered in the organizational inventory with complete documentation.
remediation_hint_template: Agent not found in inventory. Register this agent with ancilis by creating an ancilis.yaml configuration.
